DECLARE @Last_synced_version bigint = ?;

DECLARE @minimumVersion  bigint;
USE [FastwayGlobal_6]

SET @minimumVersion  = CHANGE_TRACKING_MIN_VALID_VERSION(OBJECT_ID('[PickupDashboard].[PickupRequest]'))

IF (@Last_synced_version  < @minimumVersion AND @IsReload  = 0)  RAISERROR('ERROR - Synchronization version invalid', 11, 11);


SELECT Cng.[Id]
      ,Cng.[SYS_CHANGE_VERSION]
      ,Cng.[SYS_CHANGE_OPERATION]

  FROM CHANGETABLE (CHANGES [FastwayGlobal_6].[PickupDashboard].[PickupRequest], @Last_synced_version) Cng

declare @NextVersion bigint = ?;
declare @TargetName varchar(100) = ?;


if @NextVersion IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
 UPDATE  [FastwayDW].[Staging].[LoadControl_ChangeTracking] 
 SET LastSyncVersion = @NextVersion 
 WHERE TargetName = @TargetName 
END
